targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduler_runs WHERE task_group = 'ingest' AND started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') * 1000)

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_code = 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 100) FROM scheduler_runs WHERE task_group = 'ingest' AND started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') * 1000)
SELECT status FROM service_registry WHERE service_name = 'memory_server' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ingest_jobs WHERE status IN ('running', 'queued')

SELECT date_trunc('hour', to_timestamp(started_at/1000)) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_code = 0) AS "Success", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_code != 0) AS "Failed" FROM scheduler_runs WHERE task_group = 'ingest' AND started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') * 1000) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT id, mode, query, vector, status, memories_stored, created_at FROM ingest_jobs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT to_timestamp(started_at/1000) AS time, task_id, exit_code, duration_ms FROM scheduler_runs WHERE task_group = 'ingest' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20
